items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair and thermal leak detection
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured fitting, including labour, materials and one attendance. Allow €300 gross for the repair and €350 gross for thermal leak location under §§2.4.6 and 5.2.2, below the €2,500 leak-location cap; no deductible is stated.

items.description: Re-plaster and repaint exterior frost damage
items.rationale: The facade damage is attributed to outdoor frost, not escaping water under §2.4.3, and no optional exterior frost cover is shown; §§2.6.4, 3.5 and 7.1.13 therefore exclude the whole combined line. If the optional cover were confirmed, allow €2,100 gross for local re-plastering, repainting and necessary access to the affected area only.
